sentences.en: Just a spot of shut-eye has already refreshed my mind.
sentences.zh: 小憩片刻就已经让我精神焕发。

sentences.en: The restaurant is a pleasant out-of-the-way spot in New York.

sentences.en: The detective took down his oral testimony on the spot.
sentences.zh: 侦探当场记录下了他的口供。
